verdict.rationale: BigQuery documents public programmatic interfaces. These include the Storage Write API in both gRPC and REST forms with exactly-once semantics, a Rust SDK in preview (which implies an underlying public API), and ODBC/JDBC drivers for connecting applications. The official bq CLI also creates datasets, loads data and runs queries, so an agent can drive the product programmatically. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of a full documented REST API reference for query jobs and dataset/table management, auth and rate-limit documentation for API use, and independent hands-on corroboration of API-driven workflows.
